newsitem.title: INDIA: Separatist ambush kills five Indian soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Separatist ambush kills five Indian soldiers.

text.p: Separatist rebels ambushed a unit of Indian paramilitary soldiers in Kashmir, killing five and wounding three in a barrage of grenades and gunfire, police said on Friday.

Jammu police inspector-general Kuldeep Khuda said the soldiers were conducting search operations in the Margooz region, about 190 km (117 miles) east of Jammu, the winter capital of Jammu and Kashmir state.
"On Wednesday night when they were resting in the camp, they were attacked by grenades and fire by the militants," Khuda told Reuters in Jammu.

More than a dozen guerrilla groups have been waging a separatist rebellion in Kashmir since 1990. Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have died in insurgency-related violence over the past seven years.
